working_definition: Author type Tm9v (ventral, Wnt4-positive Tm9 neurons) of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas, at the developing pupal stages P15/P30/P40 (~15-40 h APF), where cells are immature neurons.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm9b (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: Mature transmedullary neuron Tm9b (FBbt:00058234; ventral, Wnt4) carries the exact synonym 'transmedullary neuron Tm9v' (FBrf0247762, the Özel usage), and FBbt:00052335 is its immature form (develops into FBbt:00058234).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm9 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch ON hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Erm/Ey temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent; the subtype-specific immature term exists.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary neuron Tm9 that targets the ventral half of the lobula. It is distinguished from other Tm9 neurons by its expression of Wnt4 (Kurmangaliyev et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature term; the stage is developing (P15-P40), which takes immature terms.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00052335 'immature transmedullary neuron Tm9b' (exact match).
